items.title: Why you probably shouldn't buy gadgets with micro USB ports
items.summary: USB-C has become the industry standard for device connectivity. Consumers are advised to avoid purchasing new gadgets that still rely on outdated micro USB ports.
items.blurb: USB-C has largely taken over where micro USB used to reign, but you'll still spot (and should skip using) some devices using the older connector.

items.title: Jensen Huang reportedly engaged a PR firm with a history of handling  high-profile sex scandals a year ago
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang reportedly hired a PR firm specializing in high-profile scandals. The firm was engaged following a 2025 report regarding business dealings involving Alice Huang.
items.blurb: The PR firm was enlisted shortly after an Oct. 2025 New York Times report described Alice Huang's business dealings with Jensen Huang, Wired reported.

items.title: Everything we know so far about the Nvidia spy scandal targeting CEO Jensen Huang
items.summary: Nvidia is investigating an affair between CEO Jensen Huang and an executive named Alice Huang. US intelligence reports have identified the executive as having potential ties to a foreign power.
items.blurb: The leather-jacketed CEO of Nvidia, Jensen Huang, has acknowledged an affair with Megaspeed exec Alice Huang, spurring an investigation by his company and intense discussions worldwide. Recent reporting noted that since last year, US intelligence reports had identified Alice Huang (no relation) as not only the exec for an AI compute company renting access to […]

items.title: Hotel giant Wyndham exposed customer data after app security lapse
items.summary: Wyndham hotels suffered a data security lapse due to a hardcoded credential left in its customer application. The company has not confirmed whether any unauthorized access to customer data occurred.
items.blurb: Exclusive: Wyndham left a hardcoded credential in its customer app, allowing anyone to access customer data. The hotel giant wouldn't say if it has the ability to check for any past unauthorized access.

items.title: The pros and cons of using mesh Wi-Fi
items.summary: This article explores the trade-offs between mesh Wi-Fi systems and traditional standalone routers. It helps users determine which networking setup best suits their home range and budget needs.
items.blurb: Should you buy a mesh Wi-Fi system or a standalone router? Learn how each handles range, roaming, and cost, and which one fits your home best.

items.title: A short seller flagged Nvidia CEO’s ties to a suspected Chinese spy six months before the scandal
items.summary: A short-selling firm called Culper Research raised concerns about Jensen Huang’s relationship with a Chinese executive months before the current scandal. These findings preceded public revelations regarding the Nvidia CEO.
items.blurb: Six months before Nvidia's spy scandal erupted, Culper Research was already questioning Jensen Huang's unusually close relationship with a Chinese executive.

items.title: The race is on to sue Nvidia
items.summary: Nvidia stock declined as the company faces potential legal action regarding its handling of the Jensen Huang scandal. Experts suggest that earlier claims of the situation being normal may create significant legal liabilities.
items.blurb: Nvidia’s stock slid more than 4% after its board opened an investigation into Jensen Huang’s relationship with a suspected Chinese spy, and one securities law expert says the company’s earlier insistence that it was all “normal” could turn into a very expensive problem.

items.title: MSI’s refurbished QD-OLED gaming monitor is on sale for under $300
items.summary: MSI's refurbished QD-OLED gaming monitor is currently available for a significant discount at Woot. The deal offers a 27-inch screen at a reduced price until November 18th.
items.blurb: One of the best upgrades you can make to your PC gaming setup is an OLED monitor. Fortunately, MSI’s factory-reconditioned Mag 272QP X24 is on sale at Woot through November 18th with a 180-day manufacturer warranty for $290.99, which is more than $100 cheaper than the full MSRP of $399.99. items.title: The global pledge to use AI for climate good is a cruel joke
items.summary: The author expresses skepticism regarding corporate pledges to use AI for environmental benefit. The piece questions the sincerity and real-world effectiveness of these high-profile sustainability promises.
items.blurb: At this point, reading through the latest splashy pledge to use AI for the good of the environment feels like downing a nonalcoholic beer. Admittedly, I'm suspicious from the onset. items.title: YouTube will once again be part of Billboard chart calculations in 2027
items.summary: Billboard plans to reincorporate YouTube streaming data into its chart calculations starting in 2027. The methodology will be adjusted to place greater emphasis on free, ad-supported listening.
items.blurb: Billboard will give more weight to free, ad-supported listening in its methodology.

items.title: 5 Nintendo Switch 2 features everyone should know about
items.summary: This article outlines five useful features for the Nintendo Switch 2. It covers practical tips to help users improve their gaming experience, including controller management and game sharing.
items.blurb: From finding hidden controllers to sharing games with others, improve your gaming experience on the Nintendo Switch 2 with these useful features.

items.title: Apple starts offering $50 extended usage packs for AI features in Creator Studio
items.summary: Apple is introducing paid extended usage packs for its AI features within Creator Studio. Users will need to purchase additional access once they exceed their monthly allotment for Logic Pro's AI assistant.
items.blurb: It'll cost you to access Logic Pro's AI assistant after you reach the monthly usage limit.

items.title: Fervo now has $12B in orders for its geothermal power tech
items.summary: Geothermal energy company Fervo has secured $12 billion in orders for its drilling technology. The firm aims to compete with natural gas by reducing the costs associated with geothermal extraction.
items.blurb: Geothermal company Fervo is targeting natural gas as it brings down geothermal drilling costs at its 8.4 GW resource in Utah.

items.title: Jensen Huang pulls out of ElevenLabs Summit amid Nvidia controversy
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has withdrawn from the ElevenLabs Summit. This follows his previous cancellation of an appearance at an Anthropic event amidst ongoing controversy.
items.blurb: The Nvidia CEO also pulled out of an Anthropic event earlier.

items.title: Windows 11 is finally adding an easier way to disable the Sticky Keys pop-up
items.summary: Windows 11 is introducing a simpler method to disable the Sticky Keys pop-up notification. A new checkbox will allow users to turn off the feature easily.
items.blurb: There's a checkbox that simply turns it off.

items.title: YouTube streaming data returns to Billboard charts, ending major disagreement
items.summary: YouTube will resume providing streaming data to Billboard for its charts starting in 2027. The decision follows a resolution to include more weight for free, ad-supported music streams.
items.blurb: YouTube will resume sharing streaming data with Billboard in 2027 after changes to the chart formula give more weight to free, ad-supported music streams.

items.title: How to use your iPhone to take the best picture of the Moon
items.summary: This guide provides instructions on how to capture high-quality photographs of the Moon using an iPhone. It offers tips applicable to various models of the device.
items.blurb: We explain how to take the best photos of the Moon with your iPhone, regardless of which model.

items.title: Anthropic releases new Mythos and Fable models amid RSI concerns
items.summary: Anthropic has launched its new Mythos and Fable AI models, focusing on improved reasoning, coding, and vision capabilities. The release addresses recent concerns regarding repetitive strain issues.
items.blurb: Anthropic says the new models "show improvements in areas like coding, reasoning, and vision," as well as in communicating more clearly with users.

items.title: AI hardware startup Nominal triples valuation to $3B in 8 months
items.summary: Nominal, an AI platform for hardware engineering, has seen its valuation triple to $3 billion in eight months. The company continues to gain traction, counting Anduril as a major customer.
items.blurb: Nominal, a startup that offers an AI platform for hardware engineering and claims Anduril as a major customer, has raised another big round of financing that triples its valuation.

items.title: France blames Iran for mass-hacks targeting freezers in grocery stores and blood banks
items.summary: The French government has attributed recent cyberattacks against grocery store freezers and blood banks to Iran. These attacks targeted industrial refrigeration systems across Europe.
items.blurb: France's foreign minister blamed Iran for launching at least two waves of cyberattacks targeting industrial refrigerated and freezer units across France and wider Europe.
